prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create an exceptionally polished, production-quality high-fidelity desktop web app screenshot for ACT Study Lab, a redesigned four-subject ACT learning product. A game-like learning path inspired by Duolingo's motivation combined with Brilliant's hands-on educational clarity, but an original identity, not a clone. This is a real web UI design, not a poster or photo. Render one complete flat front-on desktop viewport 1536x1024, edge to edge, no device frame, no browser chrome, no collage, no perspective. Large crisp meticulously aligned legible UI text, plenty of breathing room, a warm rounded humanist sans (Nunito Sans-like). Cool white and very pale blue surfaces, ink navy #172442 text, saturated cobalt #3556EE primary, fresh lime #C7EE78 success, lilac #BCA6FF, coral #FF9D88 as controlled subject accents. Confident round 14px corners and pressable buttons with subtle 3px bottom edges. Fine clean geometric subject icons and precise functional educational diagrams. No gradients, glassmorphism, cartoon mascot, empty decorative art, trophies dominating the page, gimmick currency, or dark mode. Clear contrast and accessible large targets. Brand text exactly "ACT Study Lab" with a simple four-piece geometric mark. Main nav labels "Today", "Course", "Practice", "Progress", "Settings". Include test-date planning "Test day · Dec 12" and "60 min/day" plus understated "Edit plan". All times are approximate planning estimates, never countdowns. Include a tiny bottom label "Example plan" so sample progress is honest. Show all four subject names English, Math, Reading, Science. Original short educational content only. Current Math lesson example: a bike rental costs $3 to start plus $2 per hour, formula C = 3 + 2h. A correct graph has Hours on x, Total cost ($) on y and points (0,3), (1,5), (2,7), (3,9), (4,11), with line starting at (0,3). Draw clean exact axes and coherent plot.
COMPOSITION C — LESSON FIRST. The first viewport enters actual learning directly. Spacious 1536x1024 flat web-app screenshot, no device frame. Small minimal left 180px sidebar with logo text on two lines "ACT Study Lab", quiet primary nav Today, Course, Practice, Progress, Settings. A top line across main shows a back chevron "Today's path" left, and "Test day · Dec 12   ·   60 min/day   Edit plan" right. Below show four horizontal subject steps with geometric colored nodes: English check (lime), Math active (cobalt), Reading (lilac), Science (coral). Math active reads "2 · Math".
Below steps, large title "Build the cost, one hour at a time." On next line "$3 to start. Add $2 for every hour." In tiny secondary pill "~15 min lesson".
The main educational workspace fills remaining main area in two columns: 62% interactive artifact left, 38% guiding question right. Left is one large correct clean coordinate graph: Hours on x from 0 to 4 and Total cost ($) on y from 0 to 12, blue straight line from (0,3) through (1,5),(2,7),(3,9),(4,11); selected point (2,7) has a clear lime callout "$7". Under graph visible tactile controls "−   2 hours   +" and a large clean formula "3 + 2 × 2 = 7". Right is a teaching panel titled "First, a smaller step." This is the compassionate incorrect-answer scaffold, use pale lilac background and navy text, not an alarming red error. Small text "Keep the $3 starting cost. Add $2 once." Below two large clean price tiles "$3" and "+ $2" joined into "$5" as a visual explanation. Below ask "What does 1 hour cost?" with four large two-column answer buttons "$2", "$3", "$5", "$6"; "$5" is selected in cobalt with white text and a check. Under choices a concise success sentence "Yes. Starting cost + one hour." Bottom right a full-width cobalt button "Try a fresh question →". A small progress indicator at lower left "Learn  ✓   Explore  ✓   Practice  2 / 4". Bottom quiet text "Saved automatically" and "Example plan".
This is a premium hands-on study workspace, energetic but extremely readable; the interactive mathematical artifact dominates. No dashboards full of metrics, no mascot, no rewards overlay, no generic greeting. Respect all arithmetic and labels exactly.
purpose: User-requested mockup before implementation; illustrative progress only.
approval: User selected Daily path home + focused lesson screen on October 17, 2026.
